_comment: Expected Workers Builds bundle per worker. index.js sha256 from `wrangler@<wrangler> deploy --dry-run` run in workers/<name>. A PR that changes a bundle on purpose updates the hash here in the same PR (`node scripts/ci/check-worker-bundles.mjs` prints the new one). `watch` mirrors the Cloudflare Workers Builds trigger path_includes; the check fails if the bundle pulls in a file no pattern covers. Read by scripts/ci/check-worker-bundles.mjs.
